## Natural history notes

A tiny native livebearing fish characterized by its slender body, small size, dark side stripe, and rounded fins. In Florida, it is found in shallow freshwater habitats such as marshes, ponds, ditches, swamps, canals, and vegetated edges of lakes and streams. It feeds on tiny aquatic invertebrates, algae, and organic particles, often occurring among dense aquatic vegetation where it uses cover for protection.
